review.verdict: No blocking code finding in the focused cumulative review. All 15 are needed to reproduce the reviewed source from the observed C00 base. Candidate is apt for local integration with proportional post-integration verification; no remote approval.
review_notes: Attempt/job/worker/asset/bucket/key/snapshot identity is copied before awaits and checked at writer and persistence boundaries.
Typed R2 resume verifies prior part bytes/checksums and refuses crossed scopes, truncated/changed streams, reordered or malformed persisted parts.
Typed R2 divergence and completion uncertainty preserve artifacts and persisted attempts; the legacy abort branch is explicitly excluded when persistence is supplied.
Provider writes are preceded by authorize RPC; record/complete reauthorize server-side. SQL revalidation remains the authority.
Multipart completion accepts only exact persisted winner identity/upload/count/digest; unknown outcomes do not become acknowledged success.

Source is streamed in bounded output chunks; adaptive queue uses configured threshold/part size. Seen response IDs and page digests grow with bounded captured rows; arbitrary helper-provided giant chunks are not separately constrained.
S3 signing uses an immutable payload copy, no redirects, bounded strict UTF8/XML response and 30-second request/body deadline. External errors are sanitized.
Photo emits one main column and 1-5 independently keyed media rows; historical versions and never-answered questions come from explicit sealed schema.
Literal OOXML escape sequences/control characters are preserved; unfaithful numbers/unsupported text fail with explicit constants, not silent coercion.
The 11 prerequisite commits had historical evidence but were not independently approved by this reviewer until this focused pass.
remaining_gates: Zero responses intentionally returns zero_respostas_aberto; no version selection invented.
Existing format-1 or ambiguous attempts need nominal reconciliation/cutover treatment; v2 writer does not consume format-1 snapshots.
Unknown remote completion, orphan MPU and physical R2 cleanup remain unresolved by offline evidence; no automatic delete/abort authorization.
COELO_FORMS_WEB_ORIGIN requires an authorized configured HTTPS origin; actual protected media route/R2/UI flow still needs real verification.
Local integration must verify final nominal blobs and execute proportional tests. Source migration editing in a local replay is not authorization for remote historical rewrite.
